services.name: MiniRail Rental
services.desc: Out of town (Prince George, BC) events are $600 plus mileage, meals and accommodation. The minimum width for the Cottonwood Express is 80 ft. The optimum set up space would be 84 ft x 168 ft. The minirail track can be configured differently (large or small oval, large or small square) for your events

services.name: School Field Trips
services.desc: Enhance your visit to the Central British Columbia Railway and Forestry Museum by adding a Homeschool Education Program. The CBCRFM maintains that all students have the right to education, including the opportunity to discover local history. To accomplish this, we provide several “hands-on” lesson plans, which present supplementary knowledge about resources and extraction. Furthermore, the Education Programs are offered on-site, at the CBCRFM, through ‘program kits’, available through the front desk at the CBCRFM.
